value.rationale: The natural, nonbipartite friendship-token family has a previously known exact optimum but not an identified complete degeneracy. A full count of all labeled optimal cuts and a sharp asymptotic concentration law distinguish local frustrated-triangle flexibility from a strongly selected global hub pattern. The formula is a full infinite-family structural enumeration rather than small numerical improvements.
